questions.q: Score this recitation on the rubric: Nuh 71:1 to 4, two prompts, one muttasil read as 2 counts, steady pace.
questions.a: Hifdh 3 (two prompts); rules 3 (muttasil short); fluency 4; target: keep muttasil 4 or 5.

questions.q: How many surahs are in Juz' Tabarak?
Breakout pairs: recite today's manzil to a partner who marks the rubric (pupil PDF). Today's rota group recites 74:1 to 10 to the teacher.
questions.a: Partner rubric and one target; the teacher records rota scores.

questions.a: Day by day plan for 67 to 71.

options: Older surahs revised on a rota
questions.a: A) Older surahs revised on a rota. Manzil is the older memorised portion on a rota.

questions.q: Think again: You will finish Juz' Tabarak (67 to 77) by the end of Year 9. What has to happen every week to keep the first surahs strong?
questions.a: A manzil rota so Al-Mulk to Nuh are revised every week, not only the new surah.
